title: Attachment Metadata Entity v1
description: Metadata only. Raw bytes are the object referenced by attachment/{id}/bytes.
$comment: The payload id must equal the UUID segment of its attachment/{id}/metadata EntityKey. The metadata byteCount must equal the paired raw-byte entry after object read-back. displayName is a name, never a path; dot and dot-dot are rejected by semantic validation. v1 omits mediaType because novelpkg has no authoritative MIME value; OS inference or byte sniffing must not affect Snapshot identity.
